faqs.q: Sec. 98-67. - Retailer or vendor liable for tax.
faqs.a:
Every retailer, vendor and wholesaler shall be liable for the collection of the tax
               as provided for in this article for sales at retail to the user or consumer, by adding
               the tax imposed hereby on the average equivalent to the sale price or charge as a
               separate and distinct item, and when added such tax shall constitute a part of such
               total price or charge and shall be a debt from the consumer or user to the vendor
               until paid and shall be recoverable at law in the same manner as other debts.
(Code 1981, § 31-42; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
